name: hoare
description: Hoare-logic correctness review: states pre- and postconditions, loop invariants and variants for named functions, derives the verification conditions with language-specific hazard obligations for C/C++, Python and Fortran, and discharges each by a declared prover check or a written argument. Every obligation carries an honest status (mechanized, modeled, argued, assumed, refuted, unknown), so an argued proof is never reported as a machine-checked one. Ships a read-only verifier agent that answers a verifier-report, a /hoare:review prompt and a build-review playbook.
